warmup.description: Activate major muscle groups and prep for fast-paced strength-power intervals.

main_exercises.name: Block 1: Strength-Power Intervals (45s work / 15s rest)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Use light-to-moderate dumbbells where applicable; choose a load that allows continuous movement with effort around 8-9/10
main_exercises.form_cue: Focus on powerful, controlled reps rather than rushing through movements.

main_exercises.name: Block 2: Descending Ladder (10-8-6-4 reps)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight or light load; aim to move quickly while maintaining good form
main_exercises.form_cue: Push pace as reps decrease, but keep movements clean.

main_exercises.name: Finisher: EMOM (Every Minute on the Minute) x 5 minutes
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight; aim to complete reps quickly and use remaining time as rest
main_exercises.form_cue: Stay consistent across minutes—avoid going all-out too early.

cooldown.description: Gradually bring heart rate down and stretch fatigued muscles.
movements: Standing hamstring stretch x 45s per side

phase_notes.menstrual: This high-impact, high-intensity session is not ideal here—consider swapping for a lower intensity or reducing volume significantly if attempted.
phase_notes.follicular: You’ll likely feel capable of pushing intensity—aim to move powerfully in dumbbell work and keep transitions fast in the ladder.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Great phase for explosive output—maximize effort in thrusters and jump lunges while maintaining control in core work.
phase_notes.early_luteal: You can maintain strong performance—focus on pacing in the EMOM to avoid early burnout and sustain intensity.
phase_notes.late_luteal: This session may feel especially taxing—consider simplifying the ladder or reducing jump-based movements to manage fatigue.
